title: 車用空調熱泵系統
summary: 以乘客和熱工程師角色比較冷暖需求，明列除濕、除霜與附件用電。
summaryEn: Compare heating/cooling needs as passenger and thermal engineer, including dehumidification, defrost and auxiliary electricity.
scope: 依公開原理編寫的原創汽車與交通工具教學。所有數值均為明示假設，不是同名車輛的實測規格、認證或維修設定。使用試算表、紙面圖、合成資料及自行準備的離線模型；不提供真實高壓、道路、壓力設備或控制器操作授權。
scopeEn: Original automotive teaching based on public principles. All numerical inputs are explicit assumptions, not measured named-vehicle specifications, certification criteria or maintenance settings. Use worksheets, paper diagrams, synthetic data and offline models you prepare; no authorization for real high-voltage, road, pressure-equipment or controller operations.

stages.title: 系統邊界與現場觀察
stages.description: 以可核對的機制、算例、操作與診斷逐步建立證據。
stages.descriptionEn: Build evidence through mechanisms, worked examples, actions and diagnosis.

steps.title: 熱泵加熱性能：機制與觀察
steps.titleEn: Heating coefficient of performance: Mechanism and observation
steps.objective: 辨識 熱泵加熱性能 的機制，說明可觀察的因果關係。
steps.objectiveEn: Identify the mechanism of Heating coefficient of performance and its observable causal relationships.
steps.instruction: 本課觀察對象為熱泵壓縮機、換熱器及風門。熱泵搬運環境熱而非只把電變熱，因此COP可大於1；不同邊界會改變數值。
steps.instructionEn: This course follows heat-pump compressor, heat exchangers and air doors. A heat pump moves ambient heat, so COP can exceed one; measurement boundaries change the value.
steps.observation: 獨立教學工況，非原廠或實測規格；跨單元整合須先統一輸入及分配邊界：COP=Qheat/Pelec；Qheat=6000 W、Pelec=2000 W；計算結果=3 1。
steps.observationEn: Independent teaching operating point, not OEM or measured specifications; reconcile inputs and allocation boundaries before cross-unit integration: COP=Qheat/Pelec; Qheat=6000 W, Pelec=2000 W; result=3 1.
steps.failure: 結霜、除霜與輔助加熱會改變平均COP；不能只取最穩定的一分鐘。
steps.failureEn: Frost, defrost and auxiliary heating change average COP; do not select only the best steady minute.
steps.check: COP=3；能量平衡需6000=2000+4000 W。 將此判讀連回熱泵壓縮機、換熱器及風門的資料，記錄量測位置、邊界與資料版本。
steps.checkEn: COP is 3, with the balance 6000=2000+4000 W. Relate this interpretation to heat-pump compressor, heat exchangers and air doors and record measurement locations, boundaries and data version.

steps.instruction: 本課觀察對象為熱泵壓縮機、換熱器及風門。乾空氣顯熱模型不含凝結潛熱；空調總負荷還需濕度與新風比例。

steps.observation: 獨立教學工況，非原廠或實測規格；跨單元整合須先統一輸入及分配邊界：Qdot=mdot cp DeltaT；mdot=.15 kg/s、cp=1005 J/(kg K)、DeltaT=20 K；計算結果=3015 W。

steps.checkEn: Sensible heat is 3015 W; temperature difference alone cannot determine cooling during dehumidification. Relate this interpretation to heat-pump compressor, heat exchangers and air doors and record measurement locations, boundaries and data version.
